conceptual assets.information: The state records whether debug authentication is currently valid, which the surrounding debug system depends on to recognize an authenticated session.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality no: the RTL exposes only an authentication status at valid_o, not a secret credential (66). Integrity yes: wdata_i(0) can directly modify authenticated_q when we_i is asserted (56-57), and enable_i can clear it (54-55). Availability yes: clearing authenticated_q drives valid_o low, withholding the authentication result needed by the debug system (55,66). Undermined Expected Behavior no: the RTL shows no privileged-mode, override, bypass or test-packet behavior acting on this state.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could assert we_i with wdata_i(0) set to one to forge authentication, or drive enable_i low to clear the state and deny debug access.

conceptual assets.information: The write command determines whether the supplied write value may update the authentication-valid state; it has no output because the RTL only consumes it as the write condition.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality no: we_i is a control command rather than secret information. Integrity yes: we_i authorizes an external write that changes the security-relevant authentication state (56-57). Availability yes: holding we_i low blocks the required authentication-state write (56). Undermined Expected Behavior no: no separate override, bypass or privileged integration behavior is shown.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could suppress we_i to prevent authentication or assert it with attacker-controlled write data to alter authenticated_q.

conceptual assets.information: The enable control determines whether the authentication state can be retained or is cleared, affecting whether the debug authentication function remains usable.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality no: enable_i is a control input and the RTL does not treat it as secret information. Integrity yes: enable_i controls clearing of the authentication-valid state (54-55). Availability yes: forcing enable_i low clears authenticated_q and causes valid_o to remain low (54-55,66). Undermined Expected Behavior no: the RTL shows no distinct privileged-mode, override or bypass behavior.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could force enable_i low to clear authenticated_q and keep valid_o deasserted, disabling authenticated debug operation.

considered, not kept.reason: re_i is never read or used by the RTL (26), so it has no demonstrated security-relevant use or violation mechanism.
rdata_o is assigned only the constant zero value (69), so it carries no security-relevant state or data.
busy_o is tied to a constant zero (63), so it does not report or control a meaningful design state.
clk_i only times authenticated_q and is excluded as a clock rather than being information protected under these questions (49,53).
rstn_i only resets authenticated_q and is excluded by the clocks-and-resets rule (51).

reply keys: the 2026-10-13 format as written in 'raw'; 'reply' holds it in v5 keys
